verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. Term by term the same: Lean's `correction` is literally (r'K − r'^2 K_{r'}) f_{r'}, and u^2 * timeResidual is u^2 K f'/(qL). The only rewritings are bookkeeping: the factor 1/(qL) sits inside the Lean integrand (timeDenominator h t z does not depend on the integration variable u, so it factors out to the paper's 1/(qLr^2) prefactor), and the two integrals are written separately over Ioi r and divided by r^2 once. Lean's statement additionally carries explicit hypotheses the paper leaves implicit: integrability of the three integrands and a vanishing-boundary condition for the integration by parts (the hv/hc/hT/hb arguments).
